title: 2000 AMC 10 Problem 3
statement: Each day, Jenny ate \(20\%\) of the jellybeans that were in her jar at the beginning of that day. At the end of the second day, \(32\) remained. How many jellybeans were in the jar originally?

solutions.text:
Since Jenny eats \(20\%\) each day, \(80\%\) remain at the end of each day.

If \(x\) is the original number, then \[(0.8)^2 x = 0.64x = 32,\] so \(x = 50.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Eating \(20\%\) leaves \(80\%\) of the jellybeans at the end of each day
